title: Rates for Infants, Children and Assisted Travellers on the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Certain travellers on a booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands are priced off the adult base fare rather than at it, and certain kinds of carriage carry their own line. Those rates are scheduled here.

## 1. Definitions

1.1 The **infant share** is the percentage of the adult base fare charged for an infant travelling on the lap.
1.2 The **child discount** is the percentage discount off the adult base fare for a child aged 2 to 11.
1.3 The **unaccompanied minor fee** is charged per unaccompanied minor per direction.
1.4 The **pet-in-cabin fee** is charged per pet carried in the cabin.
1.5 The **special assistance lead time** is the number of hours before departure by which special assistance must be registered.

## 2. Schedule

| Fare brand | Infant share (percent of adult base fare) | Child discount (percent) | Unaccompanied minor (USD per direction) | Pet in cabin (USD per pet) | Assistance lead time (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 10 | 0 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 72 |
| Economy Saver | 10 | 0 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 72 |
| Economy Classic | 10 | 5 | 150.00 | 125.00 | 48 |
| Economy Flex | 10 | 10 | 150.00 | 125.00 | 48 |
| Premium Economy Select | 10 | 10 | 150.00 | 125.00 | 48 |
| Business Saver | 10 | 15 | 125.00 | 100.00 | 24 |
| Business Flex | 10 | 20 | 125.00 | 100.00 | 24 |

## 3. Notes

3.1 The infant share is scheduled at 10 percent on every brand and so never distinguishes one brand from another.
3.2 The child discount is scheduled at 0 percent on Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver, which is to say that those two brands carry no child discount at all; it rises through 5, 10, 10 and 15 percent to 20 percent on Business Flex.
3.3 The assistance lead time shortens as the brand rises, from 72 hours to 24.

## 4. Hypothetical arithmetic

On a hypothetical Business Saver booking with an adult base fare of 800.00 USD, the schedule prices an infant on the lap at 10 percent of that fare, being 80.00 USD, and a child aged 2 to 11 at the fare less the scheduled 15 percent, being 680.00 USD. On a hypothetical Economy Saver booking at the same fare, the child discount scheduled is 0 percent, so the child is priced at the full 800.00 USD while the infant is still priced at 80.00 USD.
